root_cause_matrix.diagnosis: PopSign and the narrow ASL Citizen school-assignment raw-video route are approved for local training/validation. SemLex/ASL-LEX is blocked before training. Source rights alone do not explain why PopSign and ASL Citizen training attempts fail, but they eliminate SemLex/ASL-LEX as a current training input.

PopSign and ASL Citizen have local manifests and tensors. SemLex/ASL-LEX lacks a repo-local usable metadata/phonology surface and media permission. First-party collection is policy-clean but not currently materialized into a training manifest in this slice.

The high-signal ASL Citizen manifests expose 139/139 rgb_regions_grid_v1-compatible tensors, and the TCN path can tiny-overfit one clip per label. The manifest/schema path is therefore usable enough to load labels and tensors, although no label currently passes crop/data-quality gates into a training-worthy subset.

PopSign and ASL Citizen selected splits are signer-disjoint with zero train-to-heldout signer overlap. That is appropriate evidence, not a leak, but current models train-fit or tiny-overfit without held-out transfer. Thin held-out support and signer/domain spread make broad retries unjustified.

ASL Citizen high-signal tensors are present, but unresolved crop-stat drift and held-out label behavior exclude every label from a training-worthy subset. PopSign Detector 0/crop-normalization has manual coarse target support and train-fit, but held-out detector behavior repeats failure. The smallest unblock is a crop/ROI contract repair, not another recognizer training run.

The training loop is not proven dead: PopSign reaches train_top1=1.0 under the crop-identity-preserving config, ASL Citizen TCN tiny-overfits seven clips, and no pretrained components are needed. These positives do not translate into held-out signal, which points back to data/crop/generalization rather than a pure codepath failure.

This mission forbids Brev commands. The current evidence does not justify paid remote compute because no nonempty training-worthy subset or crop-normalized input contract has been repaired. Brev may be useful later only after a bounded receipt records worker state, listed price, command, max runtime, max spend, kill condition, expected metric signal, copyback, and default-off cleanup.

Missing full hand, posture, and face landmarks are not a current required blocker and remain disallowed as pretrained/generated shortcuts in the promoted lane. The current blocker is narrower: missing reliable reviewed coarse ROI/crop supervision that transfers to held-out signers and can justify recognizer inputs.
The browser model remains not_trained and activeLabels is empty. Required audits pass. This correctly blocks promotion but does not block local diagnostic repair work.
